query:
Both Claudette and Vera expressed concern about parking in relation to the no. 22 planning application. Who was specifically concerned about parking being blocked during construction works, and who was opposed to the development on character grounds?

Options:
A. Claudette
B. Femi
C. Jordan
D. Vera
context:
[1] (about=Claudette, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) Opposes residents' parking scheme; sees £80/year as burden on residents who parked freely historically.
[2] (about=Claudette, core, t4 @2025-05-19T08:53:00) Wants driveway at no. 19 included in note; that corner has been bad for months.
[3] (about=Claudette, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) Street parties are what Maple Street is for, not parking schemes.
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Claudette, group-interaction, t4 @2025-05-19T08:53:00) Include driveway at no. 19 in the note.
[5] (about=Femi, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) Broadly in favour of residents' parking scheme; concerned about commuter overflow onto next street.
[6] (about=Femi, core, t1 @2025-05-12T15:15:00) Initiates discussion on Residents' Parking Zone consultation; wants to know where everyone stands before the meeting.
[7] (about=Femi, profile, t0 @2025-05-05T11:04:00) Proposes keeping objection on the street first before going to council.
[8] (about=Jordan, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) Neutral on residents' parking scheme (no car); thinks £80 is steep.
[9] (about=Marcus, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) Supports residents' parking scheme; believes permits would fix school gate parking problem.
[10] (about=Vera, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) Supports residents' parking scheme; needs parking for home visits on clinic days.
[11] (about=Vera, core, t0 @2025-05-05T11:04:00) Already sent individual objection to council; main concerns: scaffolding access, parking disruption.
agent_answer:
Vera was specifically concerned about parking being blocked during construction works (her objection mentioned scaffolding access and parking disruption).

As for who was opposed to the development on character grounds: there is no information available in the conversation to answer this question. Claudette’s recorded concerns relate to the parking scheme and the driveway note, not to character-based opposition to the no. 22 development.
